newsitem.title: FINLAND: Raisio has U.S. approval for Benecol deal.
newsitem.headline: Raisio has U.S. approval for Benecol deal.

text.p: Finnish food and chemicals group Raision Yhtyma Oy said on Tuesday it had won U.S. government approval for a deal with a unit of Johnson & Johnson to use its stanol ester fat product in North America.

"On July 15, 1997, Raisio announced an agreement with McNeil Consumer Products Company, a Johnson & Johnson company, to grant exclusive North American rights to the dietary ingredient, stanol ester, which is patented for use in reducing serum cholesterol," Raisio said in a statement.
"This agreement was subject to U.S. government approvals which now have been granted," it said.
Benecol is used in Finland as the brand name for a margarine based on the stanol ester fat product.
